research.question: What current empirical evidence directly supports a cross-app primary-information hierarchy or progressive disclosure for novice wellness logging?
research.reason: Explicit request for current external research and protocol research gate; fresh general web discovery/retrieval was unavailable.

sources.title: Barriers and Negative Nudges: Exploring Challenges in Food Journaling
sources.claim: Prior research record reports a survey of 141 mixed-experience journalers and 5,526 forum posts identifying food-journaling/search/portion friction; indirect to this UI and not a disclosure experiment.

sources.title: Investigating Preferred Food Description Practices in Digital Food Journaling
sources.claim: Prior research record reports a two-week study with 15 participants and 1,008 logs, mainly prior journalers; not novice hierarchy evidence.

sources.published_or_updated: Latest changelog entry reported as 2025-06-09; page-level date not established

research.summary: Reused source details from the verified prior chair retrieval in docs/agent-runs/mm205-novice-mobile-experience/findings/research.md. Current general web search/retrieval was not observed; a bounded research delegation returned a maximum-depth error. No fresh research result is claimed.
research.limitations: Evidence is indirect and does not establish that card count causes user difficulty, that progressive disclosure improves this app's task success, or which required data should be prominent. Current research capability blocked.
